newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Weather-Occasional rains seen over Sri Lanka.
newsitem.headline: Weather-Occasional rains seen over Sri Lanka.

text.p: Sri Lanka's metereological department released the following rainfall figures for 24 hours ending Monday morning.

The department said sky over the southern half of the island will be cloudy. Occasional showers accompanied by thunder will be experienced in the Western, Central, Northcentral, Uva, Sabaragamuwa and Southern provinces.
Fairly strong westerly winds will prevail over the western slope of central hills. Seas off western and southern coasts will experience showers. Seas will be rough, it added.
